text:
Predicates:
Suck(x) ::: x sucks.
HouseholdAppliance(x) ::: x is a household appliance.
Premises:
Suck(plungers) ::: Plungers suck.
Suck(vacuums) ::: Vacuums suck.
Suck(vampires) ::: Vampires suck.
Space(vacuum) ::: Space is a vacuum.
¬Suck(duster) ∧ HouseholdAppliance(duster) ::: A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck.
Conclusion:
∀x (HouseholdAppliance(x) → Suck(x)) ::: If something is a household appliance, it sucks.
